fields.Name: T120 - AI Prompts List View Column Sort
fields.Description: Exercises prompt-management's custom in-component sortable table (sortBy/sortColumn/sortDirection on client-side filteredPrompts) plus its view toggle - a hand-rolled table, not the generic AG-Grid entity grid sort.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Prompts section. Switch the view toggle from Grid to List so the prompts appear as a table. Click a sortable column header such as 'Name' or 'Status' once, then click it again. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the table renders with clickable column headers and clicking a header changes the row ordering (a sort indicator/arrow appears and rows reorder), or a valid empty state is shown when there are no prompts.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Grid/List toggle switches the prompts into a table with column headers (Name, Category, Type, Status)
Clicking a column header applies a sort - a sort indicator appears and/or the row order changes, and clicking again reverses it
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
